structure.guhs.knabbelpark.tooltip: A big pink park with a fountain, statues, Fawnguhs and the Park Ranger Guh (Guhmension)
block.guhs.park_bankje.lore: With two guh ears on the backrest. Sit for a bit, do nothing for a bit
block.guhs.park_lantaarn.lore: Put it on two cherry fence posts: a lamp post like in Nibble Park
block.guhs.park_prullenbak.lore: Throw something in (right-click) and it eats it. NYEG! Nice things it spits out again
block.guhs.park_eigen_beeld.lore: Right-click one of your own guhs with it: it poses and the statuette starts to look like it
gui.guhs.park.prullenbak.0: NYEG! The litter bin smacks its lips.
gui.guhs.park.prullenbak.2: The litter bin burps softly. Pardon!
gui.guhs.park.prullenbak.te_mooi: Nyeg? That's far too nice to throw away! The litter bin spits it out again.
gui.guhs.park.plaquette.1: In honour of Joostvadsje, who always takes good care of trapguh.
gui.guhs.park.plaquette.2: In honour of Liekguh and Lunde, guardians of all guhs
gui.guhs.park.plaquette.3: In honour of Grandpa Cheeseguh, who accidentally sat down on a little cheese and so invented the very first cheese nibble. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.park.beeld.joostvadsje: Joostvadsje, in bronze. He looks very proudly at trapguh.
gui.guhs.park.beeld.trapguh: Trapguh, small and in bronze, on the step of the pedestal. So cute!
gui.guhs.park.beeld.liekguh: Liekguh, in white stone, with her little golden nose ring.
gui.guhs.park.beeld.lunde: Lunde, in white stone, with a heart on his forehead. He looks after all guhs.
gui.guhs.park.beeld.opa_kaasguh: Grandpa Cheeseguh, in old bronze, on his famous little cheese.
gui.guhs.park.al_gevoerd: This Fawnguh has had its treat already. Feed another one!
gui.guhs.park.poseert: %s strikes a pose! The statuette looks just like it now.
quest.guhs.reis.vaste_naam: %s belongs to this spot, with this name. It stays that way!
quest.guhs.park.wachter.hallo: Welcome to Nibble Park, nyeg! I'm the park ranger. I look after the flowers, the benches and the Fawnguhs. Do you feel like helping me for a day?
quest.guhs.park.wachter.park: This park was made in honour of a few very special guhs. Their statues stand in the statue garden. And at the back live the Fawnguhs: guhs with teeny tiny antlers. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.park.wachter.start: Lovely! Start in the statue garden: read the three plaques by the statues. Then you'll know who we honour here.
quest.guhs.park.wachter.plaquettes: Have you read the plaques yet? You have %s of %s. They stand in front of the statues.
quest.guhs.park.wachter.herten: The Fawnguhs are hungry! Give each of them a cheese nibble, over the fence of the deer pen.
quest.guhs.park.wachter.verzorger: The pen keeper could use a hand. She sits by the hay bales next to the deer pen.
quest.guhs.park.wachter.klaar: You honoured the statues, fed the Fawnguhs and helped the keeper. What a park day! And you know what? A Fawnguh would really love to come with you...
quest.guhs.park.wachter.beloning: Here's your very own Fawnguh! Take good care of it, just like Joostvadsje does for trapguh. And this statuette is for your guh: just let it pose. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.park.wachter.later0: Lovely weather in the park today, isn't it? Nyeg.
quest.guhs.park.wachter.later1: Do you throw your bits of paper in the litter bin? It loves that.
quest.guhs.park.wachter.later2: How is your Fawnguh doing? It may always come and visit!
quest.guhs.park.wachter.later3: Sitting on benches is a craft too. I practise every day. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.park.optie.park: What kind of park is this?
quest.guhs.park.verzorger.hallo: Hi! I look after the Fawnguhs. They're a little shy, but crazy about cheese nibbles.
quest.guhs.park.verzorger.voeren: You've fed %s of the %s Fawnguhs. Each one wants one, over the fence!
quest.guhs.park.verzorger.klusje: Will you help me? The hay rack is empty. Bring me %s wheat, then the Fawnguhs get lovely hay tonight.
quest.guhs.park.verzorger.tekort: You have %s wheat, I need %s for the hay rack.
quest.guhs.park.verzorger.dank: How sweet! The hay rack is full again. Hurry to the park ranger, he has something for you.
quest.guhs.park.verzorger.terug: Hurry to the park ranger in his little hut!
quest.guhs.park.verzorger.later0: The Fawnguhs like to sleep under the little shelter best. Shhh.
quest.guhs.park.verzorger.later1: Polishing antlers is quite hard, you know. They tickle!
quest.guhs.park.verzorger.later2: Thanks to you they've become totally chonky. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.park.hint.plaquettes: Read the three plaques in the statue garden (right-click).
quest.guhs.park.hint.herten: Feed each Fawnguh in the deer pen a cheese nibble (right-click with a cheese nibble).
quest.guhs.park.hint.verzorger: Talk to the pen keeper by the hay bales next to the deer pen.
quest.guhs.park.hint.hooi: Bring the pen keeper wheat for the hay rack.
quest.guhs.park.hint.terug: Go back to the park ranger in his little hut.
quest.guhs.park.hint.beeld: Right-click one of your own guhs with the statuette: it strikes a pose!
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.hertguhtje: A guh with teeny tiny antlers and white spots. The Fawnguhs live in the deer pen of Nibble Park and are crazy about cheese nibbles. Help the park ranger, and one may come along with you.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelpark.uitleg: The Park Ranger Guh could use some help: read the plaques, feed the Fawnguhs and help the pen keeper. Then a Fawnguh may come along with you!
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelpark.stap.0: Talk to the Park Ranger Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelpark.nu.0: Talk to the Park Ranger Guh in his little hut in Nibble Park.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelpark.nu.1: Read the three plaques by the statues in the statue garden.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelpark.waar.1: The statue garden of Nibble Park
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelpark.nu.2: Give each Fawnguh in the deer pen a cheese nibble.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelpark.waar.2: The deer pen of Nibble Park
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelpark.nu.3: Talk to the pen keeper by the deer pen and bring her wheat for the hay rack.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelpark.nu.4: Go back to the park ranger: he has something for you.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelpark.nu.klaar: Done! Your own Fawnguh is coming along. Wahoog!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.park_gevonden.title: Nibble Park
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.park_gevonden.desc: Somewhere in the &dGuhmension&r lies a big pink park, with little walks over the hills, benches, lanterns and loads of flowers. The &6Super Compass&r shows the way (tab Cozy).
In his little hut sits the &dPark Ranger Guh&r. Talk to him: he could use a helping hand.
Read the three &6plaques&r by the statues of Joostvadsje and trapguh, Liekguh and Lunde, and Grandpa Cheeseguh. Right-click a plaque.
Three &dFawnguhs&r live in the deer pen. Give each of them a cheese nibble, over the fence.
Help the &dPen Keeper Guh&r by the hay bales: she needs wheat for the hay rack.
Back at the park ranger you get your very own &dFawnguh&r and a &6statuette of your guh&r. Let your guh pose: right-click it with the statuette!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.park_hertguhtje.des: Take a close look at a &dFawnguh&r: its page in the Guhdex fills in (a bonus page: it doesn't count for 'collected everything').
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.park_prullenbak.des: Throw something in a &6Guh Litter Bin&r (right-click with something in your hand). It eats it with relish. Nice things it simply spits out again.
